context: Importer lives beside the phase-3 module; dry-run into a scratch DB first, produce a machine-checkable parity report (67/67, per-record field diff, dangling-link count), review it, then production import. Bulk path only: libsql write delegation is ~0.15s/statement (~10 items/min row-by-row per hosted-ops memory) — batch via the importer's Hrana-pipeline bulk path, never loop per-row against the primary. One artifact-restore proof: export a findings-inclusive snapshot to the CI artifact channel and restore it into a clean DB, verifying finding_events round-trip.
description: Import the 67 Markdown records (66 tracked + 1 untracked capture) into the findings tables with a FALSIFIABLE parity definition — the adversarial review (M4) found 'lossless parity for triage history' unfalsifiable as written because triage history is free-text '## Triage log' prose. Parity here means: verbatim body sections (Finding / Why this matters / Suggested next steps) and every frontmatter field preserved; each triage-log line imported as one finding_events row with action='imported_triage_log' and prose intact; status map open->open, actionable->actionable, actioned->actioned, dismissed->dismissed, merged-to-todo->promoted. Dangling todo_id policy (drop semantics reserve ids forever; YAML-era ids may not exist): resolve each todo_id against the live DB; danglers import as finding_links(kind=promoted-to, target_item=NULL) plus a note, and the parity report counts them explicitly. After production import the Markdown tree is FROZEN (capture already redirected in phase 1) for one full planning cycle before phase 6 deletes it.

anti_patterns.dont: Delete or edit record files in this phase
anti_patterns.why: The freeze cycle is the requirement-2 proof window and the rollback path

anti_patterns.dont: Parse triage-log prose into structured disposition events
anti_patterns.instead: One imported_triage_log event per line, prose verbatim
anti_patterns.why: Unfalsifiable parity: either trivial (blob) or unachievable (prose parsing); structured guesses corrupt the audit trail

anti_patterns.dont: Row-by-row writes against the hosted primary for the import
anti_patterns.why: ~0.15s RTT per statement; measured ~10 items/min — an hours-long accidental import (hosted-ops memory)

preserves.behavior: Every record's body sections verbatim (hash-verified) and all frontmatter fields
Production items domain untouched by the import (findings tables only)
The 67 Markdown files themselves untouched until phase 6 (frozen, not deleted)
Triage-log prose intact as imported_triage_log events — no parsing-lossy structuring

prior_art.concept: Triage lifecycle the status map must honor — status->disposition mapping defined above
Bulk importer with collision handling and Hrana pipeline — same bulk mechanics, findings target
